data.title: 冬夜暖桌下的白袜试探
data.location: 只亮落地灯的冬夜客厅暖桌旁
data.lighting: 暖桌橙光、台灯暖黄与屏幕淡蓝微光
data.camera: 暖桌对侧平视微仰中景
data.prompt: adult, 1girl, solo, ayachi_nene, nene_r18, oversized cream cable-knit sweater slipping off one shoulder, bare collarbone, caramel corduroy shorts, white knit over-knee socks, sitting at kotatsu, chin resting on hands, leaning across low table, lifting edge of quilted kotatsu blanket with bare-toed socked foot, coy shy blush, looking at viewer, warm table lamp, dim television blue glow, tangerines and tea mug on table, cozy night living room, medium shot
data.animaCaption: Resting her chin on her palms across the low kotatsu while her oversized cream knit slips off one shoulder, she glances up with a coy blush as the quilt edge shifts around her socked toes. Warm lamp light and faint blue television glow mingle across the tangerines and tea mugs between you.
data.promptProse: Seen from across a low wooden kotatsu in a hushed winter living room, Ayachi Nene leans forward on her elbows in an oversized cream cable-knit sweater that falls loosely off one bare shoulder, paired with caramel shorts and thick white over-knee knit socks. Resting her chin against her sleeves with a shy, teasing blush, she lets one corner of the quilted blanket lift slightly to hint at her socked foot nudging closer beneath the table. A warm shaded floor lamp gilds her silver hair and the porcelain tea mugs on the tabletop, balanced by a soft cool blue reflection from an off-screen television.
data.story: 深夜客厅只亮着落地灯和屏幕淡淡的蓝光。宁宁把下巴埋在过长的毛衣袖口里隔着暖桌看你，被褥底下却悄悄伸出穿着厚白袜的脚尖轻碰你的小腿，被你反手握住脚踝时瞬间红了眼尾——「明、明明是你先说脚冷的嘛。」
